messages:
Priya K (Product): Heads-up — we need a concise, quantitative GA exit matrix by EOD Friday. Focus: SLA targets, monitoring guardrails, docs + support runbook, and pricing thresholds. I sketched a starting point below.

Ben H (ENG): ACK. Can you paste the sketch?

Priya K (Product): sure — short table idea: 

```
Exit axis | Required metric | Threshold | Owner
SLA latency p95 | API gen p95 (ms) | < 300ms prod | Ben
Error rate | 5xx / token requests | < 0.2% / day | Cara
Monitoring coverage | Alert on high-latency + token-exhaust | yes (100%) | Cara
Docs | Quickstart + migration guide + known-issues | published + reviewed | Lena
Support runway | Oncall playbook + runbook | 2-week burn-in + rotas | Alice
Pricing guardrail | Cost per 1K tokens | <= $X (pilot) | Marco
Rollout slice | % traffic at GA cut | <= 30% then ramp | Priya
```

Cara S (SRE): That SLA p95 <300ms is okay for hosted; for Dedicated we'll need separate targets. Also want an N+1 alert on KV cache tail latency.

Ben H (ENG): Agree. Also need to call out sequence-len buckets — p95 target changes a lot at 4k tokens. Propose we add two buckets: <=512 and >512.

Priya K (Product): good call. Update: make SLA row per bucket — can we own draft numbers, @Ben?

Ben H (ENG): I'll draft numbers by tomorrow noon.

Marco L (FinOps): On pricing guardrail: let's set a pilot threshold rather than fixed $X. Suggest: "cost per 1k tokens <= 0.7 * current-hosted-baseline" and flag if 90th percentile of customers would exceed. We need a finite escape hatch for enterprise deals.

Lena D (Docs): I'll start a GA doc checklist — items: Quickstart, SDK examples, migration notes for embeddings, SLA page, troubleshooting, FAQ. Can someone drop the final SLA table when ready so I can slot it into the docs?

Alice M (Ops): Oncall/runbook: want explicit escalation tree + rollback criteria. Also confirm oncall capacity during rollout (first 2 weeks): 24/7 for hosted, oncall buddy for private.

Priya K (Product): Flag: we must capture commercial exceptions for Private customers — Marco, can you own exception flow?

Marco L (FinOps): Yes. I'll own exception flow + pricing override approval matrix. Will propose thresholds and approval chain by Wed.

deploy-bot: CI check: smoke tests for model-serving passed on staging @1743220500. See https://ci.internal/reports/1743220500

Cara S (SRE): Thanks. Need a monitoring acceptance checklist: 1) synthetic probes per region, 2) end-to-end latency tracing enabled, 3) per-model token billing telemetry, 4) alert runbook linked. I'll write a ticklist.

Priya K (Product): Good. For rollout slices: propose three-phase: 1) GA pilot (5-10% customers) 2) Ramp to 30% over 2 weeks 3) Full GA. Need explicit rollback triggers at phase boundaries (e.g., sustained error rate >0.5% or cost >1.2x projection). Thoughts?

Ben H (ENG): rollback triggers sound right. Add degraded-quality detection from evals (prompt set regression) as a trigger. I'll wire in an automated eval CI job.

Lena D (Docs): For runbooks, please include exact commands / links. Example snippet for emergency fallback: 

```
# switch traffic to fallback model
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/route -d '{"route":"fallback-v1"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
```

Alice M (Ops): @oncall-bot can you publish the rota for the first 14 days after GA?

oncall-bot: Rota published: https://oncall.internal/ga-rotas (ops lead: Alice; escalation path: Cara -> Ben -> Marco).

Priya K (Product): Great. Action owners summary: @Ben SLA + sequence buckets, @Cara monitoring + alert-runbook, @Lena docs + runbook pages, @Marco pricing guardrails + exceptions, @Alice oncall + rollbacks. I'll collate and send for stakeholder sign-off tomorrow.

Ben H (ENG): I'll add the SLA draft as a CSV to the planning doc.

Marco L (FinOps): Also recommend a short pricing sensitivity table for worst-case cost scenarios. I'll add a 3-scenario sheet (base / high / extreme).

Cara S (SRE): One more: confirm we have burn-in traffic generators for 72h at projected GA QPS. If not, we should schedule.

Priya K (Product): Noted. If anyone has blockers to their deliverables, flag them here. Otherwise I'll create the sign-off thread after we have the SLA numbers and the pricing scenarios. :thumbsup:

Alice M (Ops): No blockers from ops side.

Lena D (Docs): I'll have the docs skeleton by EOD Thursday.

Ben H (ENG): SLA numbers by tomorrow noon.

Marco L (FinOps): Pricing scenarios by Wed.

Cara S (SRE): Monitoring checklist by Thu.

Priya K (Product): Thanks all — bringing this into the GA playbook doc once items land.
